# Student and Parent Rules

## Student section

Three written reprimands within one academic year may lead to expulsion.

## Parent section

A student who receives three written reprimands within one academic year is expelled.

## Equipment depreciation fee

The depreciation fee must be paid again at the start of the next academic year. If no damage to school equipment occurred, the depreciation fee is carried over to the next academic year.
